## Chapter 4 · Boundary Layers {#ch4}

| Quantity | Expression | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Displacement thickness | $\delta^* = \displaystyle\int_0^\infty \left(1 - \dfrac{u}{U_\infty}\right) dy$ | [§4.2](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-bl-thickness); nominal $\delta$: $u = 0.99U_\infty$ |
| Momentum thickness | $\theta = \displaystyle\int_0^\infty \left(1 - \dfrac{u}{U_\infty}\right)\dfrac{u}{U_\infty}\, dy$ | [§4.2](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-bl-thickness) |
| Shape factor | $H = \delta^*/\theta$ | laminar flat plate 2.59, turbulent $\approx 1.3$--$1.4$ |
| BL scaling (laminar) | $\dfrac{\delta}{L} \sim Re_L^{-1/2}, \quad C_f \sim Re_L^{-1/2}, \quad \dfrac{\partial p}{\partial y} \approx 0$ | [§4.3](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-bl-equations) |
| Prandtl BL equations | $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 0, \quad u\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x} + v\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\dfrac{1}{\rho}\dfrac{dp}{dx} + \nu\dfrac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}$ | [§4.3](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-prandtl-equations); $u = v = 0$ at wall, $u \to U_\infty(x)$ |
| Outer flow | $-\dfrac{1}{\rho}\dfrac{dp}{dx} = U_\infty \dfrac{dU_\infty}{dx}$ | Bernoulli just outside the BL |
| Blasius equation | $f''' + \tfrac{1}{2} f f'' = 0, \quad \eta = y\sqrt{U_\infty/\nu x}, \quad u/U_\infty = f'$ | [§4.4](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-blasius); $f''(0) = 0.33206$ |
| Blasius results | $\dfrac{\delta}{x} = \dfrac{5.0}{\sqrt{Re_x}}, \ \dfrac{\delta^*}{x} = \dfrac{1.7208}{\sqrt{Re_x}}, \ \dfrac{\theta}{x} = \dfrac{0.664}{\sqrt{Re_x}}$ | [§4.4](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-blasius-thickness) |
| Laminar skin friction | $C_f = \dfrac{0.664}{\sqrt{Re_x}}, \quad \overline{C}_f = \dfrac{1.328}{\sqrt{Re_L}}$ | [§4.4](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-blasius-friction) |
| Momentum integral equation | $\dfrac{d}{dx}(U_\infty^2\theta) + \delta^* U_\infty \dfrac{dU_\infty}{dx} = \dfrac{\tau\vert_{y=0}}{\rho}$ | [§4.5](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-mie); laminar and turbulent |
| MIE, alternative form | $\dfrac{d\theta}{dx} + (H+2)\dfrac{\theta}{U_\infty}\dfrac{dU_\infty}{dx} = \dfrac{C_f}{2}$ | zero $dp/dx$: $d\theta/dx = C_f/2$ |
| Drag of a flat plate | $D = \rho U_\infty^2\, \theta(L), \quad \overline{C}_f = 2\theta(L)/L$ | per unit width, one side, $dp/dx = 0$ |
| Parabolic profile (MIE) | $\dfrac{\delta}{x} = 5.48\,Re_x^{-1/2}, \ \overline{C}_f = 1.460\,Re_L^{-1/2}, \ H = 2.5$ | [§4.5](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-approx-profiles) |
| Turbulent BL equation | $U\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial x} + V\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial y} = -\dfrac{1}{\rho}\dfrac{dP_\infty}{dx} + \dfrac{1}{\rho}\dfrac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\mu\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial y} - \rho\overline{u'v'}\right)$ | [§4.6](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-turbulent-bl) |
| Wall units | $u_\tau = \sqrt{\tau\vert_{y=0}/\rho}, \quad u^+ = U/u_\tau, \quad y^+ = u_\tau y/\nu$ | [§4.7](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-log-law) |
| Viscous sub-layer | $u^+ = y^+$ | $y^+ \lesssim 5$ |
| Log law | $u^+ = \dfrac{1}{\kappa}\ln y^+ + C, \quad \kappa \approx 0.4, \ C \approx 5.2$ | $30 \lesssim y^+$, $y \lesssim 0.2$--$0.3\delta$ |
| Defect law | $\dfrac{U_\infty - U}{u_\tau} = -\dfrac{1}{\kappa}\ln\dfrac{y}{\delta} + B$ | outer region |
| Turbulent flat plate (1/7 law) | $\dfrac{\delta}{x} = 0.37\,Re_x^{-1/5}, \ \dfrac{\theta}{x} = 0.036\,Re_x^{-1/5}, \ C_f = 0.0577\,Re_x^{-1/5}$ | [§4.8](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-turbulent-flat-plate); $H = 9/7$ |
| Turbulent drag (empirical) | $\overline{C}_f = 0.074\,Re_L^{-1/5}, \quad \theta/x = 0.037\,Re_x^{-1/5}$ | theory: $0.0721$, $0.0360$ |
| Transition | $Re_{cr} = U_\infty x_{cr}/\nu \approx 3$--$5\times10^5$ | [§4.9](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-transition) |
| Virtual origin | $\theta_{\text{lam}}(x_{cr}) = \theta_{\text{turb}}(x_{cr}) \Rightarrow \dfrac{U_\infty(x_{cr}-x_0)}{\nu} = \left(\dfrac{Re_{\theta,cr}}{0.037}\right)^{5/4}$ | [§4.10](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-combined-bl); then use $x - x_0$ |
| Wall curvature | $\mu \left.\dfrac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right\vert_{y=0} = \dfrac{dp}{dx}$ | [§4.11](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-separation-criterion) |
| Separation | $\left.\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right\vert_{y=0} = 0 \ (\tau_w = 0)$, needs $dp/dx > 0$ | [§4.11](../notes/ch4.qmd#sec-separation); Falkner--Skan: $\beta = -0.1988$ |
